dedupe_keys.name: horaires de depart des trains passant par la gare de laval

description: Horaires de départ des trains passant par la gare de Laval is a dataset listed in data.lamayenne.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données présente les heures de départ des trains régionaux (TER) ou nationaux (TGV) passant par la gare de Laval. Des informations supplémentaires telles que le nom du réseau, le numéro du train, ainsi que la direction du train sont disponibles. Coverage: Mayenne. The portal files it under Territoires, Mobilité. Its keywords are Gare, TER, TGV, train, Transport, horaires. The portal shows 131 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-lamayenne-fr-portal.
